end.summary:
Practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere.
Matched dice, tin cans, ice-cream cones and other objects to 3D shapes.
Described cube faces as squares and cylinder surfaces as curved with circular ends.
Recognised that a cylinder remains a cylinder when turned.
Distinguished a sphere from a flat circle; a brief bowl/hemisphere question was resolved during discussion.
end.parentNote: Asha practised 3D shape names, everyday-object matching, and recognising shapes in different positions. Ishita explained the features of cubes, cuboids, cylinders, cones and spheres, including why a turned cylinder is still a cylinder. They briefly wondered whether a round bowl was a hemisphere, then later correctly described a football as a sphere and a circle as flat. At home, ask them to find one example of each shape and say one feature aloud.
